name: Mobil, mit Logo und Eigentum
before:
# Mobile locations, 105 × 52 mm polyester
label 105 x 52  margin 1
row  gap 3
  qr {{ qr }}  ecc Q  max 32
  column  gap 4
    text {{ location.unique_identifier }}  font condensed  bold  invert  height 18
    image "ZAM Logo" height 20
text "Eigentum Betreiberverein ZAM e.V."  font condensed  bold  center  height 4.5
after:
# Mobile locations, 105 × 52 mm polyester
label 105 x 52  margin 1
row  gap 3
  qr {{ qr }}  ecc Q  max 32
  column  gap 4
    text {{ location.unique_identifier }}  font mono  bold  invert  height 18
    image "ZAM Logo" height 20
text "Eigentum Betreiberverein ZAM e.V."  font condensed  bold  center  height 4.5

name: QR-Code, Kennung, Name und Ort
before:
# Locations on 57 × 32 mm labels: QR code, code, name and path
label 57 x 32  margin 1.5
row  gap 2
  qr {{ qr }}  max 25.65
  column  gap 1
    text {{ location.unique_identifier }}  font mono  bold  invert  height 30%
    text {{ location.name }}  font condensed  lines 2  height 30%
    text {{ location.descriptive_identifier }}  lines 3
after:
# Locations on 57 × 32 mm labels: QR code, title (purpose, else name), code and path
label 57 x 32  margin 1.5
row  gap 2
  qr {{ qr }}  max 25.65
  column  gap 1  align left
    text {{ location.title }}  font condensed  bold  lines 2  height 30%
    text {{ location.unique_identifier }}  font mono  bold  invert  height 30%  width auto
    text {{ location.descriptive_identifier }}  lines 3

name: Name, Preis und QR-Code
before:
# Bulk items on 57 × 32 mm labels: name, price, ID and location, QR code
label 57 x 32  margin 1.5
row  gap 2
  column  gap 0.5  align left
    text {{ item.name|default:'_______________' }}  bold  lines 3  height 50%
    row  border 0.4  shape bulge  padding 0.2 0  width auto  height 25%
      text "{% if item.sale_price is not None %}€ {{ item.sale_price|floatformat:2 }}{% else %}{{ ''|ljust:10 }}{% endif %}"  font condensed  bold
      text "{% if item.sale_price is not None %}/ {{ item.measurement_unit.short }}{% endif %}"  font condensed  height 45%  margin 0 0 0 0.5  bottom
    text "{{ label_id }}  {{ location.unique_identifier }}"  font mono  height 15%  bottom
  qr {{ qr }}  max 22.8
after:
# Bulk items on 57 × 32 mm labels: name, price, ID and location, QR code
label 57 x 32  margin 1.5
row  gap 2
  column  gap 0.5  align left
    text {{ item.name|default:'_______________' }}  bold  lines 3  height 50%
    row  border 0.4  shape bulge  padding 0.2 0  width auto  height 25%
      text "{% if item.sale_price is not None %}€ {{ item.sale_price|floatformat:2 }}{% else %}{{ ''|ljust:10 }}{% endif %}"  font condensed  bold
      text "{% if item.sale_price is not None %}/ {{ item.measurement_unit.short }}{% endif %}"  font condensed  height 45%  margin 0 0 0 0.5  bottom
    row  gap 1.5  height 15%
      text {{ label_id }}  font mono
      text {{ location.unique_identifier }}  font mono  bold  invert
  qr {{ qr }}  max 22.8
